text:
Marie: Quick sync — Integrator Orbit asked us to lock down lead-handoff rules for marketplace + SI co-selling. Proposed baseline: inbound lead -> triage 48h -> if SI engaged, create dual-ownership (SI PM + Redwood AE) and default SI credit = 30%. Thoughts?

Devin: 48h triage window sounds fine. Need flexibility on credit % by deal size. Some partners will want higher for enterprise.

Sam: SE flag: if partner requests an SE-led demo, we should log SE support hours explicitly. Also request adding `si_engaged:true` tag to intake payload so we can filter.

Anita: One more for joint announcements — require commercial commit + mutual announcement window of 2 weeks. Also legal signoff if any customer naming is used.

ops-bot: Deploy note: please use `/lead-claim` command when assigning to create audit trail. Example: `/lead-claim 12345 --partner orbit`

Marie: To formalize, draft proposal: 1) triage = 48h, 2) metadata added to lead: `si_partner`, `si_credited_pct`, `si_engaged`, `marketplace_channel`, 3) AE + SI should confirm ownership in-thread within 72h of claim, otherwise AE becomes owner. If pipeline value > $100k -> confirmation window = 96h. 4) demos: SE hours accounted and billed per playbook.

Devin: +1 to draft. I want the 72h -> 96h caveat for >$100k as you noted. Also request opt-out for certain strategic partners (we'll annotate in partner profile).

Sam: I can add the intake schema. Quick snippet I plan to push to the API gateway:```json
{"lead_id":"string","si_partner":"string","si_credited_pct":30,"si_engaged":true,"claimed_by":"string","claim_ts":"iso8601"}```

Anita: I'll create a short Confluence page with the rules, embedding the API snippet and the announcement checklist (legal, comms, embargo window). Will ping here when done. Also flagging renewal ownership is needed — we should decide if original SI credit applies to renewals or only new ARR.

Marie: Action items: @Devin update commission ops and partner profile opt-outs; @Sam add schema to intake API + set filter in the dashboard; @Anita draft Confluence doc + renewal policy proposal; ops-bot, set a 3-day reminder to review adoption.

Devin: On it, will coordinate with finance.

ops-bot: Reminder set for review: 1777780488 (2025-05-10T09:00:00Z).
